title: Core cover-relative effacement
statement: For a scheme X [def-pc-scheme], a family U of opens covering X and an abelian sheaf F, there is a short exact sequence T with T.X₁ = F. The quotient map is surjective on every nonempty U-tuple intersection, the first arrow restricts to a split monomorphism on each U_i, and every Čech connecting map [def-pc-cech-comparison-system] is surjective. No scheme Y, map Y → X or inverse-image conclusion is asserted.

source.place: Agent-written product, local splitting and Čech contraction paragraphs of the node proof, in the comparison context of Stacks Tags 01EQ and 01FD; not a statement of Tag 01FD.

proof.text: Construct the restriction adjunction by transporting Mathlib sheafPullbackIso. Define E_i = (j_i)_*(F|U_i), E = product_i E_i, and f = Pi.lift of the restriction-adjunction units. After restriction to U_i, the product projection followed by the adjunction counit retracts f by the triangle identity. A sheaf morphism zero on the cover is zero: evaluate on W intersection U_i and apply eq_of_locally_eq′ on W. Apply this to a morphism killed by f, cancel its locally split restrictions, and obtain Mono f. All objects are explicitly constructed.

Take the explicitly constructed cokernelSequence f; monicity of f and Mathlib cokernelSequence_exact give ShortExact. Restriction preserves finite limits, and its restriction adjunction gives preservation of finite colimits. ShortComplex.Splitting.ofExactOfRetraction splits the restricted exact sequence, making its quotient map split epi. Evaluate it on the preimage of any B contained in U_i; Opens.functor_map_eq_inf identifies the image open with B, giving surjectivity on B. Every nonempty tuple intersection is contained in U_(y 0). The arguments work without a nonempty index hypothesis; in the empty case all local conclusions are vacuous and sheaf uniqueness on the empty cover still applies.

For each E_i, preimage under j_i of W intersection U_i equals preimage of W. Its restriction map is therefore an isomorphism. Apply the already proved TopCat.Presheaf.exactAt_cechComplex_of_bijective, whose insertion-index contraction proves positive-degree exactness for this factor. Evaluation of a sheaf product and forgetting abelian groups preserve products; PreservesProduct.iso followed by Types.productIso identifies its sections with the dependent product of the factor sections. Project a cocycle to every factor, choose factor coboundaries from the proved factor exactness, and lift their tuplewise values through this product isomorphism. Naturality of the differential and injectivity of the product isomorphism prove this lift is a coboundary. Thus positive homology of E is zero. The tuplewise quotient surjectivity supplies shortExact_cechComplex; homology_exact₁, exact.epi_f and AddCommGrpCat.epi_iff_surjective prove each connecting map surjective.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_cechCoverRelativeEffacement_core
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u}
    (U : ι → X.Opens) (hcover : iSup U = ⊤)
    (F : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}) :
    ∃ (T : ShortComplex (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u})),
      T.X₁ = F ∧ ∃ (hT : T.ShortExact)
        (hg : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → ι),
          Function.Surjective (T.g.hom.app (op (⨅ l, U (y l))))),
        (∀ i, IsSplitMono ((U i).sheafRestrict.map T.f)) ∧
        ∀ q, Function.Surjective (TopCat.Sheaf.cechδ U hT hg q)
